name: 归档链路
desc: 勾选完成/取消（done 类、完成于/恢复于、统计与「归档已完成」可用性）、归档已完成只收当前分组范围、已归档视图与详情状态、取消归档回列表、归档项删除后从垃圾桶还原回列表、刷新后持久化；归档项删除后的 5 秒等待用宿主数值 wait 步骤

steps.eval: if (typeof T === 'undefined') { window.T = {}; } T.wipe = async () => { const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app'); const K = '__todo_test_backup_v1'; if (localStorage.getItem('__todo_test_dirty') === '1') { const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(K) || 'null'); if (o) { if (o.todos) await s.setItem('todos', o.todos); if (o.groups) await s.setItem('groups', o.groups); if (o.ui) await s.setItem('ui', o.ui); } } const snap = { todos: await s.getItem('todos'), groups: await s.getItem('groups'), ui: await s.getItem('ui') }; localStorage.setItem(K, JSON.stringify(snap)); localStorage.setItem('__todo_test_dirty', '1'); await s.removeItem('todos'); await s.removeItem('groups'); await s.removeItem('ui'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'wiped, backup todos=' + (snap.todos ? snap.todos.length : 0); }; return await T.wipe();

if (typeof T === 'undefined') { window.T = {}; } T.q = (s) => { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); const r = p && p.shadowRoot; return r ? Array.from(r.querySelectorAll(s)) : []; }; T.ready = async (sel, ms) => { const n = Math.ceil((ms || 3000) / 100); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (T.q(sel).length) return true; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } throw new Error('页面就绪超时，找不到 ' + sel); }; T.tx = (el) => el.textContent.trim(); T.click = (el) => { if (!el) throw new Error('元素不存在'); const b = el.shadowRoot && el.shadowRoot.querySelector('button'); (b || el).click(); return true; }; T.byText = (sel, t) => T.q(sel).find((e) => T.tx(e) === t) || null; T.btn = (t) => T.click(T.byText('st-button', t)); T.dlg = () => T.q('st-dialog').find((d) => d.hasAttribute('open')) || null; T.dlgBtn = (t) => { const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('当前没有打开的弹窗'); return T.click(Array.from(d.querySelectorAll('st-button')).find((b) => T.tx(b) === t)); }; T.wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms || 300)); T.NL = String.fromCharCode(10); T.setVal = (el, v) => { if (!el) throw new Error('输入元素不存在'); el.value = v; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return true; }; T.items = () => T.q('.item'); T.titles = () => T.items().map((i) => T.tx(i.querySelector('.text'))); T.need = (t) => { const i = T.items().find((x) => T.tx(x.querySelector('.text')) === t); if (!i) throw new Error('找不到任务：' + t); return i; }; T.item = (t) => T.items().find((x) => T.tx(x.querySelector('.text')) === t) || null; T.addTask = async (title, desc) => { T.btn('添加任务'); await T.wait(350); const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('添加弹窗未打开'); T.setVal(d.querySelector('.dialog-field'), desc ? title + T.NL + desc : title); await T.wait(250); T.dlgBtn('添加'); await T.wait(400); return true; }; T.toggle = (t) => T.click(T.need(t).querySelector('st-checkbox').shadowRoot.querySelector('input')); T.view = (t) => T.click(T.q('st-button-group st-button').find((b) => T.tx(b).indexOf(t) === 0)); T.labels = () => T.q('st-button-group st-button').map((b) => T.tx(b)); T.itemBtn = (t, label) => T.click(Array.from(T.need(t).querySelectorAll('st-button')).find((b) => T.tx(b) === label)); T.del = (t) => T.click(Array.from(T.need(t).querySelectorAll('.item-actions st-icon-button'))[1]); return 'helpers ready';

await T.ready('.add-group-btn'); await T.addTask('任务A', '描述A'); await T.addTask('任务B', ''); if (T.items().length !== 2) throw new Error('应有 2 条任务，实际 ' + T.items().length); if (T.titles().join(',') !== '任务B,任务A') throw new Error('新增项应排在列表首位：' + T.titles()); return 'ok';

T.toggle('任务A'); await T.wait(400); const i = T.need('任务A'); if (i.className.indexOf('done') === -1) throw new Error('勾选后应带 done 类：' + i.className); if (T.tx(i.querySelector('.meta')).indexOf('完成于') === -1) throw new Error('副标题应含「完成于」：' + T.tx(i.querySelector('.meta'))); const f = T.tx(T.q('.footer .count')[0]); if (f !== '1 项未完成 · 共 2 项') throw new Error('统计不正确：' + f); if (T.byText('st-button', '归档已完成').hasAttribute('disabled')) throw new Error('有已完成项时「归档已完成」应可用'); return 'ok';

T.toggle('任务A'); await T.wait(400); const i = T.need('任务A'); if (i.className.indexOf('done') !== -1) throw new Error('再次点击应取消完成'); if (T.tx(i.querySelector('.meta')).indexOf('恢复于') === -1) throw new Error('副标题应含「恢复于」：' + T.tx(i.querySelector('.meta'))); T.toggle('任务A'); await T.wait(400); if (T.need('任务A').className.indexOf('done') === -1) throw new Error('应重新回到已完成'); return 'ok';

T.btn('归档已完成'); await T.wait(450); if (T.items().length !== 1) throw new Error('归档后列表应只剩 1 条，实际 ' + T.items().length); if (T.item('任务A')) throw new Error('已归档条目不应出现在列表'); if (T.labels().indexOf('已归档 1') === -1) throw new Error('归档视图标签应带数量：' + T.labels()); const f = T.tx(T.q('.footer .count')[0]); if (f !== '1 项未完成 · 共 1 项') throw new Error('统计未扣除归档项：' + f); const g = T.tx(T.q('.gitem .gcount')[0]); if (g !== '1 项') throw new Error('侧栏计数未扣除归档项：' + g); if (!T.byText('st-button', '归档已完成').hasAttribute('disabled')) throw new Error('无已完成项时「归档已完成」应置灰'); return 'ok';

T.view('已归档'); await T.wait(450); if (T.items().length !== 1) throw new Error('已归档视图应有 1 条，实际 ' + T.items().length); const i = T.need('任务A'); if (i.className.indexOf('archived') === -1) throw new Error('归档项应带 archived 类：' + i.className); if (T.tx(i.querySelector('.meta')).indexOf('归档于') === -1) throw new Error('副标题应含「归档于」：' + T.tx(i.querySelector('.meta'))); if (!Array.from(i.querySelectorAll('st-button')).some((b) => T.tx(b) === '取消归档')) throw new Error('归档项应有「取消归档」按钮'); return 'ok';

T.need('任务A').querySelector('.body').click(); await T.wait(450); const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('点正文应打开详情弹窗'); const txt = d.textContent; if (txt.indexOf('已归档（已完成）') === -1) throw new Error('详情状态应为「已归档（已完成）」：' + txt); if (txt.indexOf('归档时间—') !== -1) throw new Error('已归档条目的归档时间不应是 —'); if (txt.indexOf('任务A') === -1) throw new Error('详情标题不正确'); T.dlgBtn('关闭'); await T.wait(350); if (T.dlg()) throw new Error('点「关闭」应关闭详情弹窗'); return 'ok';

T.itemBtn('任务A', '取消归档'); await T.wait(450); if (T.items().length !== 0) throw new Error('取消归档后归档视图应为空'); if (document.querySelector('o-page').shadowRoot.querySelector('.empty').textContent.indexOf('归档箱是空的') === -1) throw new Error('应显示归档箱空状态'); T.view('全部'); await T.wait(450); if (T.need('任务A').className.indexOf('done') === -1) throw new Error('取消归档应保留完成状态'); if (T.items().length !== 2) throw new Error('列表应恢复为 2 条，实际 ' + T.items().length); if (T.labels().indexOf('已归档') === -1) throw new Error('归档徒标应消失：' + T.labels()); return 'ok';

T.btn('归档已完成'); await T.wait(450); T.view('已归档'); await T.wait(400); if (!T.item('任务A')) throw new Error('归档项应出现在已归档视图'); T.del('任务A'); await T.wait(400); if (T.need('任务A').className.indexOf('pending') === -1) throw new Error('「任务A」应进入倒计时'); return 'deleted';

await T.ready('.shell'); T.view('垃圾桶'); await T.wait(450); if (T.items().length !== 1) throw new Error('垃圾桶应有 1 条，实际 ' + T.items().length); T.itemBtn('任务A', '还原'); await T.wait(450); T.view('全部'); await T.wait(450); if (T.need('任务A').className.indexOf('archived') !== -1) throw new Error('归档项从垃圾桶还原后应回到列表而非归档箱'); return 'ok';

let root = null; for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); root = p && p.shadowRoot; if (root && root.querySelector('.shell')) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } if (!root || !root.querySelector('.shell')) throw new Error('刷新后页面未就绪'); const items = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('.item')); if (items.length !== 2) throw new Error('刷新后列表应有 2 条，实际 ' + items.length); const a = items.find((i) => i.querySelector('.text').textContent.trim() === '任务A'); if (!a) throw new Error('刷新后找不到 任务A'); if (a.className.indexOf('done') === -1) throw new Error('刷新后 任务A 应仍是已完成'); if (a.className.indexOf('archived') !== -1) throw new Error('刷新后 任务A 不应是归档态'); if (root.querySelectorAll('.item.trash').length !== 0) throw new Error('垃圾桶应为空'); return 'ok';

const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app'); const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('__todo_test_backup_v1') || 'null'); if (o) { if (o.todos) await s.setItem('todos', o.todos); if (o.groups) await s.setItem('groups', o.groups); if (o.ui) await s.setItem('ui', o.ui); } localStorage.removeItem('__todo_test_dirty'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'restored';
